slides.title: Gulf of Mexico
slides.via: Down the Rio Grande to the Gulf. Down the Arkansas, Red and Mississippi rivers to the Gulf.

slides.title: Gulf of California
slides.via: Down the Colorado River toward the Gulf of California. Most is used up before it gets there.

slides.title: Nowhere: it never reaches the sea
slides.via: Into closed desert basins, where it dries up or soaks in.
